VeChain is a public blockchain platform. VeChain uses a proof-of-authority consensus mechanism. VeChain uses a dual-token model with VET and VTHO. VeChain focuses on supply chain and enterprise use cases.

Unstoppable Domains is a blockchain-based domain name service. Unstoppable Domains issues domain names as non-fungible tokens. Unstoppable Domains operates on public blockchains such as Ethereum and Polygon.

CryptoKitties is a blockchain-based collectible game on Ethereum. CryptoKitties represents each digital cat as a non-fungible token. CryptoKitties lets owners breed cats to produce new kittens. CryptoKitties was developed by Dapper Labs. CryptoKitties launched in 2017.
